components.name: Notification bar
components.description: Notification bar — a short, floating, always-dark bar that confirms an action (added to cart, saved, copied) with an optional one-word action (Undo, Open). Fixed to Dark mode so it reads on any page. Auto-hides after 4 s; one at a time. For longer messages use Toast; for page-level problems use Alert.

A short, floating, always-dark bar that confirms an action, with an optional one-word action. 8 variants · Status × Direction.
